verdicts.reason: Both shrink the side illustrations to tiny thumbnails jammed against the left and right edges under the headline, which leaves the middle of the canvas empty and makes the artwork trivial. Neither one is rearranged for the tall format. In A, 'CREATIVE AGENCY' drifts near the bottom, about 260px from CLAYTONI, so it breaks the logo lockup. B keeps the tagline a little closer, though still loosely grouped, and leaves an empty band at the bottom.
